entries.6df4528b9d0ee4f4: A reportable segment that provides chain-store outlets such as convenience stores, drugstores, fast-food restaurants and hotels with new construction, renovation, repair, cleaning and operational support, as well as the supply of building materials used in construction work. FM stands for "Facility Management," and within the Group it is limited to businesses related to commercial facilities. The company and its consolidated subsidiary AP Renovations Co., Ltd. (100.0% voting rights held) handle it. Net sales for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥14,578 million (down 0.6% from the previous fiscal year), and segment profit was ¥203 million (down 47.7%). The securities report states that renovation work requiring store operations to be suspended was postponed until the third quarter and concentrated in the fourth quarter, increasing costs such as urgent imports and delivery by charter flights, so profit did not increase even though sales increased.
entries.807c64e575aaf89a: A reportable segment that efficiently delivers indirect materials, such as tools, consumables, repair parts and stationery that companies buy on a daily basis, from order to delivery through an internet procurement system; it is the reportable segment with the larger revenue from external customers of the two reportable segments. The company is responsible for this segment. MRO is an abbreviation of "Maintenance Repair and Operations." Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥44,321 million (up 7.5% year on year), and segment profit was ¥1,186 million (up 54.2% year on year). The securities report states that the increase in profit was due to the automatic replacement recommendation feature for purchased items introduced in the electronic catalog "Mugen Catalog," which concentrated customers' purchases on best-selling products and raised the gross profit margin. On the other hand, in the fourth quarter, the impact of the ransomware attack on ASKUL halted sales to small and medium-sized businesses through ASKUL, and the resumption of shipments was also delayed, causing revenue to fall below the prior year.

entries.aca4d1a6ad23edb6: A business of IT system development and operation carried out by the consolidated subsidiary ATC Co., Ltd. (100.0% voting rights held). It is a business segment not included in the Group's reportable segments, and it sells externally the technology and know-how cultivated through developing and operating IT systems for the company. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥21 million (down 66.6% from the previous fiscal year), and segment profit was ¥78 million (down 6.4%). The securities report explains that because the profit includes profit from services for the company, segment profit arises even though net sales are small.
